# Sky

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Sky")`

What the sky shows: six images around the world, the sun's and the moon's look, stars and clouds. **It counts only directly under `Lighting`**, and only the first one there. The images are also what surfaces reflect and are lit by. **The sun stays on the clock**: its direction comes from `Lighting.ClockTime` and `GeographicLatitude` whatever the images show, so shadows and the drawn sun agree -- choose images without a sun painted in, or turn `CelestialBodiesShown` off.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CelestialBodiesShown` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the sun, the moon and the stars are drawn. Off leaves only the images and the clouds -- the light still comes from where the clock puts the sun. |
| `CloudColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write, **inert** | The clouds' colour where the sun lights them. |
| `CloudCover` | `number` | `0` | read/write, **inert** | How much of the sky the clouds cover, from 0 (none) to 1 (overcast). They drift with the game's own clock, so a paused game's clouds stand still and a replay's move the same way. |
| `CloudDensity` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write, **inert** | How thick each cloud is, from 0 (wisps the sky shows through) to 1 (solid, with dark undersides). |
| `MoonAngularSize` | `number` | `2` | read/write | How wide the moon looks, in degrees across, above 0 and at most 60. |
| `MoonTexture` | `Content` | — | read/write | An image drawn as the moon's disc at night. None draws a plain pale disc. |
| `SkyboxBack` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image towards +Z, before `SkyboxOrientation` turns the set. None of the six means the engine's own sky, drawn from the time of day. |
| `SkyboxDown` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image straight down. |
| `SkyboxFront` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image towards -Z, which a camera with no rotation looks at. |
| `SkyboxLeft` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image towards -X. |
| `SkyboxOrientation` | `vector` | `vector.create(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | Turns the six images together, in degrees about X, Y and Z -- a mountain range painted into the images is moved to where the world wants it. |
| `SkyboxRight` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image towards +X. |
| `SkyboxUp` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image straight up. |
| `StarCount` | `number` | `3000` | read/write | How many stars cover the whole sky at night, from 0 to 10,000. They come out as the sun goes down and are the same stars in the same places every night. |
| `SunAngularSize` | `number` | `2.3` | read/write | How wide the sun looks, in degrees across, above 0 and at most 60. The real sun is about half a degree; the default is larger so a sunset reads in a short day. |
| `SunTexture` | `Content` | — | read/write | An image drawn as the sun's disc, lit by the sun's colour. None draws a round, soft-edged disc. |
